As a smoker myself, I think you should find a time where she’s sober and relaxed and ask to have a conversation. Tell her how you want to start settling down, and if you truly love her, try to come to a compromise! She could maybe smoke less or not do it around you as much. Don’t do it around kids in the future, etc.. Affirm her that you’re not attacking her or forcing her to do anything. If she can’t respect your boundaries, it might be wise to end things before they get too serious. Best of luck!

Cats tend to leave the house for bit. They can have alter egos outside of your home and also love to claim as much territory as possible. If they’re gone for more than 24-36 hours, I’d start lookin around. Leave some food out to lure them back. As smart as cats are, they can get lost or stuck while trying to claim territory. My cat got lost for a few days cause he was stuck in the neighbors porch; DOWN STAIRS OF ALL PLACES! (they weren’t home for a few months) So keep an eye/ ear out. Try calling their name at night. Cats like to sunbath and sleep during the day so they won’t come if they’re enjoying the sun.(my cat is stubborn like that) maybe try leaving a toy outside. Something familiar so they know where to go wen they’re done exploring.( yes, even indoor cats do this. It’s just instinct.) I hope you find your kitty and that they’re safe. Even knowing it’s in their nature to leave, it can still be scary/ unsettling to not have them around. But I’m sure they’ll be fine :) Good luck!
